name: expression
value: median TPM per nominal code x stage (resequenced / sub-fraction columns of one code x stage pooled), then log2(TPM + 1)

name: transition_rule
value: adjacent pair (later minus earlier) over codes having both stages; candidate = n_pairs >= min_codes, high-side TPM >= min_tpm in >= min_codes_tpm codes, |median| >= min_abs_median, sign agreement >= min_sign_agree; top_transition per sign by |median| (ties by ENSG); descriptive, not a DE test

name: panel_rule
value: higher than every existing adjacent stage (same candidate rule on each contrast); end stages one neighbour; ranked by minimum adjacent effect, top_panel (ties by ENSG); empty panel allowed (not filled); DCTA experimental rule, not the authors' official panel

name: mapping_rule
value: HGNC exact ensembl_gene_id one-to-one with locus_group protein-coding gene only; other candidates listed in source_exclusions.csv

name: pb_pmn
value: peripheral-blood PMN columns kept separate (source_pb_pmn_*.csv); not used in contrasts or panels

name: independence_note
value: Paper: 4 donors + 1 biological repeat; GEO: 5 nominal collection codes (A-E). Same-person mapping not confirmed: codes are nominal collection groups, not independent donors; no donor-level CV, p-value, accuracy or bootstrap CI.
